tool_limitations.limitation: Namespace mass-rewrite (line 126) only maps `Windows.UI.Xaml` -> `Microsoft.UI.Xaml`. Sibling non-Xaml relocations (`Windows.UI.Colors`, `Windows.UI.ColorHelper`) are left untouched, so a `Windows.UI.Colors.Green` reference survives bootstrap and fails compile.

failed_apis.why_tried: Status block coloring: `new SolidColorBrush(Windows.UI.Colors.Green/Red)` in the migrated MainPage.xaml.cs.
failed_apis.root_cause: In WinUI 3 the named-color class relocated to `Microsoft.UI.Colors` (requires `using Microsoft.UI;`). Bootstrap only rewrites `Windows.UI.Xaml`, so this reference was never converted.

special_apis.special_handling: The XAML markup compiler resolves project-local `x:DataType` types (e.g. `local:Scenario`) only after the code-behind assembly compiles. A C# compile error makes Pass2 emit misleading WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509/WMC9999 errors against x:Bind even though the binding is correct.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: The type or namespace name 'Colors' does not exist in the namespace 'Windows.UI'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Windows.UI.Colors relocated to Microsoft.UI.Colors; not rewritten by bootstrap.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 'DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType' + WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly parameter...' + WMC9999 internal error
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascade from the CS0234 code-behind failure: with the assembly not compiled, the XAML markup compiler cannot resolve the project-local `local:Scenario` DataType. The x:Bind/x:DataType markup was actually correct (xmlns:local=using:Barometer, class Scenario in namespace Barometer).
errors_encountered.fix: Real fix was the CS0234 correction. The agent ALSO downgraded `{x:Bind Title}`+`x:DataType` to `{Binding Title}` (session-log.txt:2652) — an unnecessary regression from compiled to classic binding; fixing the C# error alone would have cleared the WMC errors.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: One build produced 5 errors (1 real CS0234 + 4 cascade WMC XAML errors); agent treated the XAML errors as an independent x:Bind/x:DataType problem.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~2 turns; two separate 'fixes' applied in one pass
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill does not explain that WMC-series XAML-compiler errors commonly cascade from a C# compile failure, so the agent mis-attributed them and downgraded x:Bind to Binding to make the WMC errors disappear.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Fixed Colors CS0234 and simultaneously replaced x:Bind with Binding; next build succeeded.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md x:Bind section stating: fix all CS#### errors first and rebuild before diagnosing WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509/WMC9999; never downgrade x:Bind->Binding to silence a cascade.
